headline: When Interest Becomes a Defense Policy: Jordan Builds Financing Architecture Before the $15 Billion Test
summary: Jordan's government has announced more than 40 investment opportunities worth over $15 billion, ahead of a conference to be held in November. The input frames the push as a test of financing and oversight capacity.
why: Large public investment pipelines shape infrastructure, bank lending and foreign direct investment flows in emerging economies such as Jordan.
